rationale: The original short thesis failed to see downside follow-through after the breakdown candle, with price immediately reclaiming the 5-minute 9-EMA ($64.53) and grinding back to session VWAP ($64.60). With the current price at $64.58 and buyers absorbing the prior selling pressure, exiting now preserves capital ahead of the $64.65 invalidation level. However, because volume on this bounce is very light (1.7k–5k shares per minute) and VWAP has not yet been reclaimed, there is insufficient bullish conviction to justify flipping long.
